purpose: DEV v3-v5で観測された弱点候補を公開forwardで前向きに確認する。タグは診断専用で、レース選定・予想確率・買い目・券種・予算・勝負レース指定には一切影響させない。

tags.source_timing: same leakage-safe odds snapshot used for prediction

evaluation.primary: After accumulating forward races, compare pre-frozen prediction quality and MAGI_PURE outcomes by tag versus untagged races.
evaluation.minimum_interpretation: No tag can be promoted to a strategy/filter from a single week or a small number of hits/misses.
evaluation.new_strategy_requires: new DEV hypothesis + preregistration + independent evaluation; forward tag performance alone cannot retroactively alter week-1 rules
